summary: Product weight feature (summary, auto-estimate preview/apply, bulk Isi Berat, no_weight/estimated_weight filters, Excel/editor clearing the estimate flag). Backend: 15/15 pytest pass in tests/test_pgs_iter40_weight_bulk.py after a first run with 14/15. The failing check was 'no product_events': the first Excel import and the first editor publish on a raw imported product each created an 'info' buyer event (RCA below). Frontend at 390px and 1920px: the banner counts, Tampilkan, Cek berat perkiraan, the Perkiraan otomatis dialog (search, untick, edit grams, confirm/Kembali, saved message), row badges, the Isi Berat bulk dialog (validation, only-missing skip reason, banner refresh) and the editor 'Berat perkiraan' hint/badge (removed on edit, publish stores weight_estimated=false) all work. The estimate rules misclassify several products (examples below). All weights were reverted afterwards. Deprecated packages detected: none in the files reviewed.

critical.issue: A weight-only change on a raw imported product that was never edited creates a db.product_events 'info' buyer notification. product_notify.on_info compares INFO_FIELDS of the raw doc, which lacks keys such as specs/video/condition/variant_options/subcategory/min_order/preorder, against the to_product() output, which fills in defaults ({} / '' / 'new' / []). So None != default and an event is raised. Reproduced in the first pytest run: 2 events (pgs-44248 via Excel Berat, pgs-10611 via editor). Later runs on the same, now-normalized docs created 0 events. About 6,600 of the imported products are still raw, so the first time the owner fixes their weights in Excel or the editor, buyers get 'info diperbarui' notices.

minor.issue: Bad matches: 'Rak Kulkas', 'Dispenser Kulkas 3 Liter', 'Cover Kulkas', 'Pembersih Kulkas 500 ML' -> 35000 g; 'Bantal Sofa' -> 30000 g; 'Sapu Lidi Kasur', 'Matras Yoga' -> 20000 g; 'Loyang Kaca Microwave' -> 13000 g; 'Rak TV 3 Pintu', 'Rack TV', 'Tempat Tissue HP Bentuk TV' -> TV 6000 g; 'Dutch Oven Suggo' -> Oven 9000 g (the Oven rule comes before the panci rule that lists 'dutch oven'). Underestimates, which make shipping too cheap: 'Speaker Advance 15 inch K1512-E' -> 4000 g (the aktif rule needs 'speaker 15 inch' with nothing in between); 'Kipas Angin Industri', 'Kipas Gantung', 'Kipas Angin 20″' -> 3000 g. Accessory words (rak/cover/pembersih/bantal/loyang/tempat/sapu) should be checked before the appliance rules, and size rules should allow words between keyword and size.

The preview is marked 'applied' before target_store() is checked, so a failed permission check uses up the preview. Overrides of 0 or >500000 are skipped silently, so the saved count can be lower than the 'N akan disimpan' count the owner confirmed. There is no check that preview.by is the current user. Updates run one by one (6615 updates took 2.9 s); bulk_write would be better.

ui_bugs.issue: Clearing a grams input sets 0 and the row still counts in 'Simpan N' / the confirm text, but the backend silently skips it. Block zero values or exclude them from the count.
After an Excel import, refreshWeight() is not called, so the banner counts stay stale until the screen reloads.
'0 produk berhasil diubah' is shown in success green when every product was skipped ('Sudah punya berat').

issues: The banner text links Tampilkan / Perkiraan otomatis / Cek berat perkiraan are 14px tall (58x14 and 108x14 measured; about 26px with hitSlop 6). Minimum touch target is 44px.
The 'Berat perkiraan N g' badge uses colors.warning #F59E0B at 11px on white, about 2.1:1 contrast (fails WCAG AA). Use a darker amber such as #B45309.

action_items: HIGH: In product_notify.on_info, compare fields after normalising (treat None/missing as equal to '', {}, [], 'new' and other defaults), or diff to_product(form_of(old)) against the new doc. Then a weight-only change through Excel or the editor on a raw imported product creates no buyer event.

Reorder or tighten the weight_estimate NAME_RULES: put accessory words (rak, cover, pembersih, bantal, loyang, tempat, sapu, dispenser kulkas) before the appliance rules, put dutch oven before oven, let 'speaker ... 15 inch' and 'kipas industri/gantung/20 inch' match the heavy rules.
Weight dialog: block or exclude 0-gram overrides. Call refreshWeight() after an Excel import. Make the banner links at least 44px tall. Use a darker warning colour for the estimate badge text.
critical_code_review_comments: A weight-only bulk edit rewrites price/original_price/stock/variants/tier_prices from to_form/to_product. Values stayed the same in testing, but this is a needless write path; consider $set of only the weight fields when only weight changes.
weight_previews keeps the full item list (about 6.6k rows) in one document with no TTL index. Add a TTL index on created_at, since previews are only valid for 2 hours.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows work (minor UX/design issues listed)

seed_data_creation: None kept. Cleanup done: $unset weight_grams and weight_estimated on all products (0 left), weight_previews and product_events deleted, autosaved draft dr_936da81f32 deleted. (3) A 'TEST_Toko 09880' store from an earlier iteration is visible in the admin store pills; it was not created by this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with -n 0 (pytest.ini adds xdist): cd /app/backend && EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_pgs_iter40_weight_bulk.py -n 0 -s. The module teardown $unsets weight on ALL products and deletes weight_previews and product_events (baseline: 6618 products, none with weight). test_no_product_events only catches the on_info bug on raw products; pgs-44248 and pgs-10611 are already normalized, so point the import/publish tests at untouched products to reproduce. UI login: use the /login form (setting the localStorage token pgs_auth_token did not authenticate). Do not use force=True on the bulk-bar buttons: the bar's layout shifts and force clicks hit the wrong button. Editor save = pe-publish, then 'Ya, simpan'.
rca_of_issue: product_events on weight-only change: the publish path and the import path both call product_notify.on_info(db, old, to_product(form)). to_product returns a full normalized doc. Raw imported products lack many INFO_FIELDS keys, so new[f] != old.get(f) (for example {} != None for specs) and an 'info' event is created even though only weight_grams changed. Repro: pick an untouched pgs-* product, then GET /product-editor/products/{id}, change weight_grams, and POST /product-editor/publish. db.product_events gets kind='info'. Fix: normalise before comparing, or compare only the fields the user actually changed.
